title: Nugget Name Tag (Backport)
description: Simple paper-nugget recipe! Backports name tag crafting recipe introduced in '26.1-snapshot-2' by Mojang to older versions.
body:
This datapack backports the official Name Tag crafting recipe introduced by Mojang in "26.1-snapshot-2" to earlier Minecraft versions.

You can now craft Name Tags in survival using the exact same recipe shown in the snapshot.
# 🏷️ Showcase

 ![All crafting recipes available](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eabd4a52425f61742637dc37bc34c7bfdeb44756.gif)

## ✨ Features

> 🔁 Official Mojang recipe backport _(Vanilla-friendly)_
>   
> 🛠️ Very convenient _(craft Name Tags without relying on villagers or loot RNG)_
>   
> 🛡️ Safe for existing worlds
> 
## 📦 Supported Versions


> Fully tested on **EVERY** version listed (1.21.x)


Designed to work seamlessly across all supported versions

## 📐 Recipe Details

The recipe is implemented 1:1 from the snapshot, ensuring full parity with future vanilla gameplay.
No advancements, loot tables, or unrelated mechanics are modified.

## 📥 Installation

1. Download the datapack
   
1. Place it into your world’s datapacks folder
   
1. Run /reload
   
1. Enjoy crafting Name Tags!

## 📜 Credits

- Recipe design by Mojang Studios
  
- Datapack implementation by you
